purpose: Six simplified icons based on actual film-development and darkroom equipment, for user selection.

concepts.name: 片芯螺旋
concepts.caption: 提取冲洗片芯的螺旋导轨
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one original modern Android app icon concept for SPEKTRA / 光谱暗房, an analog-film editing app.
User request: a SIMPLE, aesthetically current icon that is meaningfully based on REAL FILM DEVELOPING / PHOTOGRAPHIC DARKROOM EQUIPMENT. Previous arbitrary geometric logos and a literal 3D filmstrip-S were rejected. Recognizable physical source, strongly simplified into an ownable graphic emblem.
Art direction: refined editorial pictogram with confident large geometry, deliberate negative space, optically balanced, bold enough at 48 pixels. Flat vector-like artwork, extremely clean contour, two or three restrained solid colors. Contemporary design-studio identity rather than stock clipart or technical drawing.
Canvas: square, flat full-bleed background reaching every edge. Exactly one centered emblem occupying approximately central 58–64 percent of the canvas. No inset app tile, no frame around the canvas. Generous negative space.
Text: none. No letters, numbers, logo wordmarks, watermark, labels, guide marks or captions. No comparison board or multiple examples.
Constraints: no camera or generic lens, no cinema reel with circular holes, no letter S, no generic abstract swoosh. No 3D, mockup, realistic materials, chrome, gloss, bevel, ambient glow, gradients, drop shadows or film-grain texture. No tiny screws, microdetails or thin fragile strokes. Every shape should explain the actual equipment or process, not be an unrelated ornament.
Subject: the TOP VIEW of an actual stainless-steel darkroom film DEVELOPING REEL, strongly distilled into a clean graphic spiral. A small central circular axle hole and approximately 2.5 evenly spaced concentric spiral turns, with one subtle radial loading entrance at the outer right. It should read as the spiral channels that hold film separated inside a chemical developing tank. Outer diameter about 60 percent of canvas. A bold continuous ivory-white spiral with ample charcoal negative channels, and only the outermost short loading tip picked out in vermilion orange. Use stout consistent stroke thickness about 4 percent of canvas so the form remains clear at small sizes. Precise concentric optical rhythm. A compact mechanical spiral, NOT a nautilus, seashell, fingerprint, hypnosis spiral or cinema reel. Do not add spokes crossing the channels. Palette: uniform charcoal background #141416, warm ivory #F0E8D9 primary spiral, small orange #F66B35 entrance segment.

Subject: an actual daylight photographic FILM DEVELOPING TANK, distilled into an iconic frontal silhouette. Preserve the unmistakable wide light-tight lid, short flat cap at the very top, sloped funnel shoulder, and squat cylindrical body with gently rounded bottom. A concise stacked form made of three broad shapes: warm ivory stepped cap, dark charcoal body, a single warm ivory separation line beneath the shoulder. The tank is taller than wide, but squat and calm, centered, about 56 percent canvas height and 44 percent width. Background is a SOLID muted warm vermilion #D85D37; tank body #202022; lid and thin lip #F1E6D5. No printed labeling, no measurement ticks, no handles, no screw threads, no kettle spout, no jar opening. It must suggest a light-tight darkroom developing canister, not a coffee cup, paint bucket or battery. Strong economical silhouette with gently softened corners, flat fill shapes.

Subject: a REAL photographic print-developing TRAY seen from directly overhead, simplified into a distinctive icon. One broad rounded-rectangle orange tray rim, slightly wider than tall, with the characteristic tiny angled POURING LIP in the upper-right corner. Inside is dark charcoal developer bath. One plain warm-ivory rectangle of photographic paper sits slightly rotated inside the bath, about 65 percent of tray interior, with its lower third turning orange-red across one calm diagonal liquid boundary to suggest a print emerging in developer. No image on the paper, no landscape, mountain, sun, text or tongs. Keep the tray rim visually substantial, the paper broad, and the whole composition compact with clear dark channels. Background #141416, tray rim #F6743E, bath #242426, paper #F3EBDC. Flat solid colors, no perspective or physical surface shading. Outer tray width approximately 63 percent canvas, height 51 percent.

Subject: an actual RED DARKROOM SAFELIGHT in a simplified front / slight underside graphic view. It is a compact wall-mounted red-domed safelight, not a hanging household bulb or alarm beacon. Preserve just a short broad warm-ivory top mounting cap, a shallow charcoal protective hood, and a large RED-ORANGE semi-circular / rounded bowl diffuser below it. Subject: a REAL darkroom photographic ENLARGER distilled into a refined flat icon. A short broad rounded rectangular ivory enlarger head near the top, a small dark lens stub directly beneath it, a single broad orange trapezoid of projected light reaching toward a small ivory horizontal paper rectangle near the bottom.
